description: Live price of any token on Base, Solana, Ethereum, BNB, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism or Avalanche from DEX data: USD price, total liquidity, 24h volume, buys/sells, price change (5m/1h/6h/24h), market cap, FDV, pair count and pool age. For a full rug-pull check use token-safety. Use when you only need a token's current price, liquidity and volume. Instead, use `token-safety` ($0.02) to check it is safe. Answers may be cached for up to 30 seconds. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. In the free trial.

address.description: Token contract address (0x...) or Solana mint address. Give this or symbol.

chain.description: Chain of the token (base when an address is given without one).

symbol.description: Or a symbol (ETH, BTC, SOL, PEPE). If several tokens share it, the answer lists the top matches and asks for chain or address (not charged).

name: token-price

fetchedAt.description: When the data was fetched from its source (ISO 8601 time).

found.description: False if no source has a market or price for the token.

liquidityKnown.description: False when only a price was available.

liquidityNote.description: Present when liquidity is unknown, saying why.

liquidityUsd.description: Total USD liquidity across pools; null when unknown (only a price was available), never a false $0.

pairs.description: Number of pools; null when unknown.

poolsAsOf.description: Present when pool data is the last known (DEX sources busy): when it was fetched.

priceNative.description: Price in the pair's quote token.

resolvedFrom.description: When a symbol was given: the symbol, the chosen chain and address, its name and status (verified, likely-real, unverified), a note, and up to 3 alternatives with the same symbol.

txns24h.description: 24h buys and sells; null when unknown.

volume24hUsd.description: 24h volume in USD; null when unknown.

title: Token price ($0.005)
